descricao: The Level does not appear to have a day-night cycle, only staying at dawn. Temperatures are a consistent 21°C/70°F throughout the Level despite having ample shading in many areas. Reduced gravity within this Level does not affect native organisms, only affecting objects and entities foreign to Level 16. …Was our Level Key wrong? We've been here already. But the key changed direction. Everything looks different than what they reported…
